stops.name: Alain Prost
stops.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1991_Brazilian_Grand_Prix ('On lap 17 Prost pitted for new tyres')
stops.note: first of two planned stops; Motor Sport confirms he was first to stop. Second stop lap not given

stops.name: Nigel Mansell
stops.source: https://www.motorsportmagazine.com/archive/article/may-1991/6/formula-one-brazilian-grand-prix ('he came in on lap 25 for his scheduled tyre stop')
stops.note: Wikipedia says lap 26. Motor Sport chosen: its lap numbers match Jolpica (Mansell retired on lap 60 with 59 laps; Wikipedia says 61). Slow stop, 'over 14 seconds' (Wikipedia)

stops.name: Nigel Mansell
stops.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/1991_Brazilian_Grand_Prix ('on lap 50 Mansell had to stop for a new set of tyres after a puncture')
stops.note: puncture; stationary 9.5 s (Motor Sport). Only Wikipedia gives the lap; it ran one lap high elsewhere in this race, so check

notes: Senna (#1) and Patrese (#6) made tyre stops ('After Senna and Patrese had made their stops', Wikipedia), laps not given. Piquet (#20) and Moreno (#19) 'elected to make stops' (Motor Sport), laps not given. Senna had gearbox trouble late on (Motor Sport).
